title: Carbon Copy

objectives.text: Bernard has a plan. And a stopwatch.
Marjorie, in the lobby, with keys
Delroy knows the night man's habits
Keep Lisle at dinner. Order dessert.
Copy the ledger. Put it back.
Take the ledger. All of it.
Lisle's security on the freight stairs
objectives.note: The watchman is non-lethal; the driver's men are hired guns. Converted from the exit goto. Cops among the targets are ordinary killable police (heat only).

objectives.text: Bernard reads it on the lobby table

fail.note: Wasted: retry from checkpoint (hospital flow, Gameplay).
Arrested: retry from checkpoint (booking flow, Gameplay).
Shown as '<Name> died'. Retry from checkpoint; offer a skip after repeated failures.

mobile: The infiltration is about timing and doors (the watchman has a fixed loop shown on a radio clock), not stealth reflexes. Being spotted resets to the o7 checkpoint. Nick's dinner is a calm dialogue that the player can stretch with menu choices. Branch variants via `if` (ENGINE_REQUESTS 8).
design: **End of Act 2.** Branch A pays off. With the wire, Marjorie lets Teddy in, he copies the ledger and returns it, and she hands over her carbons (flag.have_marjorie_carbons, set in dialogue). Burned, he steals it, and Lisle knows by morning. Either way the oldest page is Mayhew's. COMBAT (26 Nov): see COMBAT table in build_act23_missions.py.
conventions: FEATURE_AUDIT 'Mission conventions': cop kills feed heat only; 'Lose the police' gates on requireNoHeat objectives; fail only for standard reasons.
